caption: The drawing features a single metal object centered on a plain, off-white background, enclosed within a thin, black, rectangular border. The object appears to be a metallic tool with a long, cylindrical shaft that exhibits a twisted pattern along part of its length. At the top, the shaft expands into a flat, closed-loop handle shaped somewhat like an irregular triangle with rounded corners. The color of the tool is mainly gray, with areas showing darker shading to indicate metallic texture and possibly rust or wear, particularly at the bottom end where the shaft flattens and curves slightly. The drawing is signed “Duvall” in small letters at the bottom right corner inside the border.
title: Stove Lid Lifter
